design_philosophy: Internal power tool optimized for speed, clarity, low friction, founder usability. Terminal-inspired dark-first, zero-clutter, strong typography. Color is function, not decoration.

components.buttons: Use flat styles. No shadows. Primary button is solid white (text black). Secondary is outline with transparent background. Mandatory data-testid attributes.
components.inputs: Flat borders (border-zinc-800), transparent backgrounds. Focus ring should be sharp (ring-1 ring-zinc-500) rather than blurred.
components.tables: Dense. border-collapse. Subdued headers using uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-xs. Data cells use IBM Plex Mono.
components.badges: Sharp corners. 1px border. Background transparent or 10% opacity of the status color.
components.dialogs: Solid background #09090B, 1px border-zinc-800, no drop shadows.

media.strategy: No decorative imagery. Interface relies solely on typographic hierarchy, grid lines, and functional color coding. Icons should be Lucide (default).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. Muted text must still be readable against #09090B.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus state (e.g., focus:ring-1 focus:ring-white).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Set the Tailwind config to use 'Outfit' for sans/headings and 'IBM Plex Mono' for mono/body data.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid: dense, data-driven, using grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with tight gaps.
Do not use Shadcn 'Card' components if they force rounded corners and shadows. Use custom <div> with 'border border-zinc-800 bg-transparent'.
Apply data-testid to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, list items) to facilitate testing.
Color is strictly reserved for statuses (Approve/Review/Rewrite/Defer). The rest of the UI must remain monochrome (Zinc 950 to White).
For the Page Workspace, use a split-pane layout (sidebar for controls/scoring, main area for draft editing).
Ensure the Quality Scorer uses monospaced numbers for scores (e.g., 85/100) for a technical feel.
Use standard HTML tags and Tailwind for layouts. Avoid heavy UI libraries where simple grid/flex will suffice.
Use Lucide icons (already installed) consistently with 1.5px stroke width.
